about: ADR 0153 / ADR 0167: the only hosts the module installer may reach, on consent. The sole package host is Cloudflare R2 behind modules.qrtz.ai (no Backblaze B2 mirror). root1Sha256 pins v1/root/1.root.json (root 1 from scripts/modules/release-keys.sh, 2026-10-18; threshold 2, both root keys; a public copy with its .sig is checked in at crates/qrtz-modules/roots/ and served at https://modules.qrtz.ai/v1/root/1.root.json). Were it null, every network install would be refused. modelMirrors are the only hosts a signed tree's extra mirror URL may point at (ADR 0157: a model file's pinned Hugging Face URL, checked by the same sha256 through the same fetcher). crates/qrtz-lifecycle/tests/offline_graph.rs checks this file.
